name: Jona Basta
source:
From: Mobile Suit Gundam NT (Narrative)
Pilot of the Narrative Gundam. Enlisted with the Earth Federation Forces, with the rank of Ensign. To capture the Phenex, he joined Operation Phoenix Hunt alongside Michele. Michele pulled strings to get him assigned to the Shezarr Team, but as a pilot, he is... merely above average.
translation:
From: Mobile Suit Gundam NT (Narrative)
Pilot of the Narrative Gundam. Enlisted with the Earth Federation Forces, with the rank of Ensign. To capture the Phenex, he joined Operation Phoenix Hunt alongside Michele. Michele pulled strings to get him assigned to the Shezarr Team, but as a pilot, he is... merely above average.
